name: @local/session-shared-blackboard
description: Agent group chat rooms plus shared-document blackboards between you and several sessions or workspaces: Markdown bubbles with avatars and @-mentions, and queued document editing that always starts from the latest read. Workspace-scoped boards auto-register sessions created in a member workspace; archived or closed sessions are recorded and cut off from communication; every session gets an identity card (blackboard_whoami).
